scientific_question: Are the V and attention c_proj failures concentrated in a temporally stable subset of layers, as required for a paper-consistent functional-LWT repair?

theory.accepted_endpoint: 124M/20TPP QK-only with dense V, dense attention c_proj, and dense MLP
causal_evidence: Generated V costs 0.0365 validation CE at 20TPP relative to QK-only.
Generated attention c_proj plus interaction accounts for about 77.6% of the 5TPP full-attention penalty.
Tenfold fixed c_proj chart capacity and activation-metric fitting did not beat equal-coordinate random orientation.
The Mapping Networks paper favors layer-wise charts when layer manifolds differ.
theory.hypothesis: If an existing target-specific Cayley orbit is useful only in some layers, early Muon-applied directions should select the same high-recovery layers at held-out late phases with a material recovery separation.
excluded: no ratio, rank, seed, or learning-rate sweep
no direct authorization of language-model training

decision_rule.selection: For each target separately, select the six layers with highest energy-weighted active-orbit recovery over early steps only; evaluate unchanged on late steps.
decision_rule.pass: A target passes only if every target-specific threshold passes. A pass authorizes one preregistered same-gauge held-out one-step functional-CE gate for that fixed layer mask, not an MFU preflight or training run.
decision_rule.fail: Keep that target dense and reject functional-LWT training in the tested Cayley family.
